scope: Guide changes only; no product implementation or approval claim

findings.change: C20 defines one typed root parser, explicit legacy native forms and query --source-adapter with no alias; old native data/streams preserved, token scanning removed; CLI/composition own executable routing regressions.

C21 enumerates complete shared return/coverage/availability/branch/format/access/recovery/output types; C22/C23 source-selection and universe types are part of the reviewed, committed wave0 freeze set and sealed baseline prerequisite.

QuerySource::load now accepts typed SourceSelection; SDK derives adapter/harness include/exclude groups before I/O and loader prunes registrations before enumeration or decoding. Excluded bad stores cannot force allow-partial.

Only range is globally single-session/branch. Context partitions per admitted matched group; multi-session queries are valid, text renders labeled groups, and expansion cannot cross repository/source/participant authority.

C23 records separate selection versus partition completeness, digests/columns/limit and bounded-input basis. Saved subset stats remain explicitly input-bounded; incomplete context/reconstruction refuses; JSONL EOF is not completeness and execute_view cannot widen admitted scope.

Every format lane now has different falsifiable dialect/availability conditions and an explicit fact-versus-SDK ownership boundary; the single SDK owner has five ordered internal proof milestones without stub delivery or a worker/test-count quota.
C17 names actual app registry/dispatch symbols and explicitly distinguishes the plan015 base from accepted plan014 9250b8f6, including its dispatch 284-304 anchor.
Schema format capabilities explicitly mark CSV losses; CSV guidance recommends JSON/JSONL where absent/null/empty must remain distinct.

factual_notes: R1's blanket wording that every declared check is BUILD/EXTEND is shorthand, not literal: existing native-regression is RUN and ac-0015's instrument is EXISTS. No new query behavior is proven either way; all 24 AC/pressure states remain unchecked.
The reviewer’s original report and open findings remain immutable; this disposition records design fixes awaiting R2, not a retroactive approved verdict.
